summary: This clinical trial is testing a combination of fecal microbiota transplantation, a calorie-restricted diet, and a medication called semaglutide in adults with obesity and type 2 diabetes. Fecal microbiota transplantation involves transferring healthy gut bacteria to a patient's digestive tract. The study has a status of Not yet recruiting and plans to enroll 20 participants. The sponsor of this research is the Eighth Affiliated Hospital, Sun Yat-sen University.
